settings_json.readingContent:
<h2>Overview</h2>

<p>This lesson gives learners a practical introduction to the week's core topic. It is designed to be read before the live session so learners can arrive with context, questions, and examples from their own workplace.</p>

<h3>What the Learner Should Focus On</h3>

<ul>
  <li><strong>Key concept:</strong> Understand the main idea behind the topic and why it matters in day-to-day work.</li>
  <li><strong>Workplace link:</strong> Think about where this topic appears in real tasks, team communication, customer handling, or process improvement.</li>
  <li><strong>KSB evidence:</strong> Notice which knowledge, skills, and behaviours could be demonstrated through this activity.</li>
</ul>

<h3>Before the Session</h3>

<p>Learners should read the material carefully, highlight any unfamiliar terms, and write down one example of how the topic applies to their own role. This example can be used in discussion or reflection later in the week.</p>

<h3>Reflection Prompt</h3>

<p>After reading, learners should answer: <em>What is one action I can take this week to apply this learning in my workplace?</em></p>

<p><strong>Completion expectation:</strong> The learner should mark this activity complete after reading the content and preparing their workplace example.</p>

HTML Preview Test Page

This page is built to stress-test an HTML preview renderer: multiple font sizes, multiple font weights, nested bullet points, numbered lists, and a handful of images pulled from a placeholder image service.

Font Size Samples

10px — tiny fine print text

14px — small body text

18px — comfortable reading size

24px — subheading size

32px — large display text

48px — big banner text

Font Weight Samples

200 Thin — The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog

300 Light — The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog

400 Regular — The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog

500 Medium — The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog

600 Semibold — The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog

700 Bold — The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog

900 Black — The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog

Bulleted List

  • Bold item — with a bold lead-in
  • Italic item — with emphasis
  • Regular item with inline code
  • Item with a nested list:
    • Nested bullet one
    • Nested bullet two
    • Nested bullet three
      • Double-nested bullet
      • Another double-nested bullet
  • Last top-level bullet

Numbered List

  1. First step
  2. Second step
  3. Third step with sub-steps:
    1. Sub-step A
    2. Sub-step B
  4. Fourth step

Mixed Heading Levels

This is an H2

This is an H3

This is an H4

This is small paragraph text (12px / weight 300).

This is normal paragraph text (16px / weight 400).

This is big paragraph text (20px / weight 400).

Single Image

Image Row (Gallery Style)

Blockquote & Combined Styles

"This is a blockquote combining a larger font size, a light font weight, and italics — useful for checking how a preview handles quoted text."

Big bold inline text next to tiny light inline text in the same paragraph.

End of test page.
